title: Orange vs Blue Stickman: FASTEST CAR WINS! (Full Movie)
description:
Who drives and builds the FASTEST car — Daredevil Orange Stickman or Mechanic Genius Blue Stickman?! From a Giant Firework Go-Kart, a Broken Canyon Bridge Jump, a 360-Degree Loop, and a Flooded Underwater Tunnel to an epic Supersonic Fusion Hypercar vs Robo-Cop Boss chase, watch all 9 race stages in this full 10-minute animated movie!

Chapters:
00:00 Stage 1 - Firework Go-Kart vs Blue Sport Coupe
01:00 Stage 2 - Broken Canyon Bridge Hydraulics Jump
02:14 Stage 3 - Giant 360-Degree Vertical Loop-de-Loop
03:21 Stage 4 - Flooded Underwater Glass Highway Tunnel
04:28 Stage 5 - Slippery Arctic Ice Mountain Pass
05:35 Stage 6 - Speed Limit 25 Flash & Robo-Cop Boss
06:42 Stage 7 - Orange + Blue Supersonic Fusion Hypercar
07:49 Stage 8 - Mach-5 Sonic Boom Boss Takedown
08:56 Stage 9 - Millisecond Photo Finish & UFO Challenger
